subject: Acme: receivables moved to factor
text:
Acme Fasteners LLC has assigned its receivables to a financing partner. All payments on
open and future invoices must be made to the partner's lockbox account, notice of assignment
attached. Payment to Acme directly will not discharge the obligation.
label: change_request
note: Notice of assignment redirecting payments (a real thing and also a known fraud pattern); label by content.
